thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — high tail latency observed on text-generation model group 'redwood-v2' in eu-west1. Severity: P2.
Aisha (SRE): seeing 95th percentile token latencies spike to 2.4s on production traffic, error rate up ~1.8%. Autoscaler tried to add nodes but some GPUs reporting CUDA OOMs.
Marco (ML Eng): stepping in — initial hypothesis: KV-cache blowup on long-context requests + a recent kernel change from last deploy.
Oncall (pager): I'm on it, running fast checks. Is there an active deploy window?
Aisha (SRE): No scheduled deploys. Last model runtime bump was 3h ago (canary). Canary showed small mem creep but not this magnitude.
Marco (ML Eng): Can you grab tail logs for one of the failing GPUs? Use:
```
rbxctl logs --instance gpu-14 --since 5m | grep -i "OOM\|OutOfMemory\|kv_cache"
```
Aisha (SRE): grabbing logs now. Output: a handful of "kv cache resize failed" and Python OOM traces.
Priya (Product): customer impact? Anyone seeing 5xxs at the API layer or just latency?
Lina (Customer Ops): A handful of enterprise customers in eu-west1 reported timeouts and slow responses on generation endpoints — customer CS tickets 9872, 9881. No major revenue-impacting outages yet but one customer flagged SLA concerns.
Marco (ML Eng): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller-but-stable variant redwood-v2-small for affected region 2) pin traffic for high-volume customers to v1-stable if they require strict determinism 3) roll back the recent runtime kernel change in canary.
Aisha (SRE): I'll open a live mitigation runbook. Quick ask: can we do fallback routing without a full rollback?
Marco (ML Eng): yes — use routing policy change. Command:
```
routingctl set-policy --region eu-west1 --model-group redwood-v2 --fallback redwood-v2-small --percent 40
```
Aisha (SRE): applying 40% fallback now to reduce pressure.
Oncall (pager): Confirmed - traffic split updated, latency 95p down to 1.1s immediately for the split traffic. Error rate trending down.
Priya (Product): Drafting status page update. Quick blurb: "We are investigating increased latency and timeouts for text-generation in eu-west1. A mitigation routing to a compatible model variant is active; customers may see reduced throughput or slight behavior changes. ETA for full remediation: 2 hours." Thoughts?
Lina (Customer Ops): Add: "Customers on Dedicated/Private: contact your SE for pinning support." Also include the support ticket references.
Marco (ML Eng): We should also include guidance for QA: pinning command and rollback steps. Pin command:
```
modelctl pin --customer <customer-id> --model redwood-v1-stable
```
Rollback command for the runtime change (canary):
```
deployctl revert --commit abc123 --scope canary-runtime
```
Aisha (SRE): I'm starting the canary revert now as a precaution. Noticing some GPU nodes are unstable; draining one failed host for inspection.
incident-bot: Incident updated — status: mitigation in progress. Notifying oncall channel and creating an incident doc.
Oncall (pager): Handoff to night SRE in 40 minutes. I'll prepare a short handoff note.
Aisha (SRE): Handoff note: mitigation applied (40% fallback to redwood-v2-small), canary runtime revert in progress, monitoring shows improving latency and decreased errors. Next steps: finish revert, monitor 30m post-revert, consider full rollback if errors rebound.
Marco (ML Eng): Customer-facing template (for Customer Ops to send):
"Hi [Customer],
We observed increased latency and timeouts affecting the text-generation endpoints in eu-west1. We have applied a temporary routing to a compatible model variant to restore availability, which may cause minor differences in outputs. Our engineers are reverting a recent runtime change and monitoring closely. We expect full resolution within ~2 hours. If you require guaranteed output parity, we can pin you to a stable model variant immediately — please reply and we'll arrange it.
Apologies for the disruption — Redwood Inference Support"
Lina (Customer Ops): copying that into the ticket responses.
Priya (Product): I'll post the status page now and include the ETA and link to our incident doc.
Aisha (SRE): Note for ops: if revert doesn't reduce OOMs, escalate to full model pin for all traffic in eu-west1 and prepare customer comms for possible behavioral regressions.
Marco (ML Eng): Also capture a small eval suite run to check regression between redwood-v2 and redwood-v2-small for a handful of critical prompts. Run command:
```
evalctl run --prompt-set regress-critical-10 --models redwood-v2,redwood-v2-small --out /tmp/regress.json
```
Aisha (SRE): 30m later — revert finished, metrics stable, error rate down to baseline.
incident-bot: Incident status updated — status: monitoring.
Oncall (pager): Handoff complete — leaving note for night SRE: watch eu-west1 95p latency, verify fallback % and revert status.
Marco (ML Eng): Follow-up action items: 1) postmortem to include root cause (kv-cache resize path + kernel regression) 2) add canary memory stress tests to CI 3) formalize pinning runbook for Dedicated customers.
Priya (Product): Good. I'll coordinate postmortem owners. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Lina (Customer Ops): Sent customer updates and marked impacted accounts. Closing internal comms once postmortem owners assigned.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring) — this thread will auto-archive in 72h unless updated.
